newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar consolidating gains by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar consolidating gains by close.

text.p: LIFFE sugar held earlier gains by the close of business on Monday, though conditions in London remained quiet.
Traders said that the market continued to consolidate after last week's falls, aided by firmer New York futures.
By 1830 GMT, active March was up $2.40 at $298.00 and dominated volume at 2,548 lots.
Much of the volume had been in trades against actuals, traders said.
On the physical front, the European Union's sugar management committee will discuss the final sugar balance sheet for 1995/96 on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
"The committee will also discuss the provisional balance sheet for 1996/97," the official said.

Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha was quoted by Interfax news agency as saying on Monday that the cabinet had proposed imposing quotas on refined sugar imports. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542-8075
